courses.title: Product Management for Aspiring Strategists
courses.description: By the end of Product Management for Aspiring Strategists, you'll be able to apply product management confidently in Product Strategist work, with a working sense of where data analysis fits alongside it. The course moves from core product management technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at data analysis woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying product management to a real Product Strategist scenario
Practicing product management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to data analysis
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Roadmap Planning in Practice
courses.description: Roadmap Planning in Practice goes beyond the basics of roadmap planning, for people already working toward a Product Strategist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in roadmap planning and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying roadmap planning to a real Product Strategist scenario
Practicing roadmap planning through guided exercises
Building a short roadmap planning exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
